alteredSource.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Dreamerie Version 4 spot-the-difference source painting. Image 1 is the edit target: the painted orchard of hanging pear-clocks, sleeping fox on a scale, ladder, watering can and embroidered cloth. Preserve exactly the same 1672x941 composition, painterly matte brushwork, colors, lighting and all background scenery. Make ONLY these five localized, physically coherent changes: (1) The sleeping fox's white-tipped tail curls over the near rim of the brass scale pan instead of resting completely inside it, with convincing overlap and no extra tail. (2) At the center of the purple ladder, one horizontal rung runs behind the tree trunk rather than visibly in front of it, preserving the ladder's geometry. (3) In the largest hanging pear-clock, the long clock hand passes behind the little central gold star ornament while the short hand remains in front, with clean layered edges. (4) The middle falling water droplet from the teal watering can reflects a tiny upside-down silhouette of a hanging clock, within the existing drop rather than adding another. (5) On the lower-left embroidered cloth, the green sprig's stem threads under then over the ivory crescent-shaped seam at its edge, as a legible little embroidery crossing. Keep the motifs, count and locations of every other object unchanged. No additional differences, global repaint, new objects, discoloration patches, text, grain or watermark. Preserve brushwork and seamless joins.
